input.text: Staff log any cash deposit or withdrawal of $7,500 or more for large cash review.
sources: Log any cash deposit or withdrawal of $7,500 or more for large-cash review.

input.text: Staff acknowledge every written complaint within 2 business days.
sources: Acknowledge every written complaint within 2 business days.

input.text: Staff escalate any complaint that alleges unfair treatment to the regional manager the same day.
sources: Complaints that allege unfair treatment are escalated to the regional manager the same day.

input.text: Staff resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.
sources: Resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.

input.text: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the approval named in this policy is given.
sources: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.
